course_description: Bridge the gap from blocks to real code! Program PicToBlox sprites using real Python statements, control Tobi's walking animations with built-in functions, code Addition Bots, build loop drawings, navigate maze games, catch apples with scoreboards, and script a fully active multi-car Street Racing game! 🐍🚗🎮✨

quizzes.title: 🐍 Python Challenge 1: Code Syntax & First Scripts
🐍 Python Challenge 3: Maze Choices & For Loop Squares
🐍 Python Challenge 4: While Loops & Bricker Physics
🐍 Python Challenge 5: Sprite Cloning & Catching Apples
🐍 Python Challenge 6: Object Classes & Street Racing
